authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: No compact kill; combo tables outrace it.
Zevlor must activate then cast in the same turn; two pieces of mana each time.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Counterspell, Swan Song, Deadly Rollick, Terminate, Chaos Warp, Feed the Swarm, Cyclonic Rift, Blasphemous Act.
value.mana: 34 lands with fetches and true duals; Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Ancient Tomb.
value.protection: Swiftfoot Boots, Pemmin's Aura shroud, Deflecting Swat.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Zevlor turns every single-target spell into one per opponent.
accepted_role.honest_note: Commander-native. The only Spellbook combo (3525-3772, Omen Hawker + Pemmin's Aura) doesn't need Zevlor. The deck has no compact kill; it wins on multiplied value and theft. The source says a generic Oracle/Breach shell can hold Zevlor but its wins don't need him, so it was rejected (verification L23; decisions L120).

reviews.question: Can the deck rebuild after repeated removal across multiple permanent types?
